name: Tadashii Shimai no Sodatekata
source:
It all started from my father's statement: "I've decided to remarry!"
I could only sigh, honestly. I've got accustomed to being flung around by his whimsical acts, but still I'm half-astounded. Ignoring my astonished state, he asserted to enact his plan regardless. 

"Rejoice, for you will have sisters, two of them!", so said my father. It was shocking. "Sister". My heart tightened at the mention of the word. To tell you the truth, I have a wish I can't tell others. That is leading a life of frolicking around and doing erotic thing with my sister everyday. Not an imaginary sister you can find in manga or games but a real one.

My wish comes true at last. My pent-up frustration was heading to a bad direction. On a certain summer day, I suddenly got myself some sisters.
(Then I have no choice but to dye them with my own color, do I?!)
With determination and hope in my heart, my field of vision warped greatly that day.
translation:
这一切都始于父亲的一句话：“我决定再婚了！”
我只能叹息，说实话。我已经习惯了被他的异想天开的举动搞得晕头转向，但我仍然感到有些惊讶。他无视我的惊讶，断言无论如何都要实施他的计划。

“庆幸吧，因为你将有两个姐妹了！”我父亲如此说道。太令人震惊了。“姐姐”。一提到这个词我的心就揪紧了。说实话，我有一个愿望不能告诉别人。那就是每天和姐姐嬉闹、做色情事情的生活。不是漫画或游戏中想象的妹妹，而是真实存在的妹妹。

我的愿望终于实现了。我压抑的挫败感正朝着不好的方向发展。在某个夏日，我突然多了几个姐妹。
（那我就只能染上自己的颜色了不是吗？！）怀着心中的决心和希望，那天我的视野发生了很大的扭曲。
